question: What equipment do we use to hit the shuttlecock in the air? 🏸
explanation: Super! We hold a badminton racket in our hands to strike the shuttlecock over the net! 🏸
hint: It has strings and a handle.

question: What is another fun name for the shuttlecock? 🪶
explanation: Awesome! Many people love to call the shuttlecock a 'birdie' because it has feathers! 🪶
hint: It sounds like a small flying animal.

question: What separates the two sides of a badminton court? 🥅
explanation: Great job! A tall net stands in the middle of the court for players to hit the shuttlecock over! 🥅
hint: It has lots of tiny holes.

question: What part of the racket actually hits the shuttlecock? 🎾
explanation: Fantastic! The tight strings on the racket head give the shuttlecock a big bounce! 🎾
hint: They look like a spider's web.

question: What do we do to start a game of badminton? 🏸
explanation: Brilliant! We serve the shuttlecock over the net to begin the fun game! 🏸
hint: It means to offer or start the play.

question: Where do we hold the badminton racket? ✊
explanation: Super! We hold the grip on the handle to swing the racket safely and strongly! ✊
hint: It is the bottom part of the racket.

question: What must we look at when we want to hit a good shot? 👀
explanation: Awesome! Keeping our eyes right on the shuttlecock helps us hit it perfectly! 👀
hint: Look at the object you are hitting.

question: What happens when you hit the shuttlecock over the net and it touches the floor? ⭐
explanation: Great job! You score a point when the birdie lands safely on the other side of the court! ⭐
hint: It helps you win the game.

question: What do we wear on our feet to run safely on the court? 👟
explanation: Fantastic! Sports shoes help us run, jump, and stop safely without slipping! 👟
hint: They have good grip for running.

question: How many players are playing in a 'singles' match? 🧍
explanation: Brilliant! In a singles match, it is one player playing against one other player, making two in total! 🧍

question: What shape is the bottom base of the shuttlecock? 🔴
explanation: Super! The bottom is a round cork that gives it a great bounce off your strings! 🔴
hint: It is shaped like a small ball.

question: What do we call a very strong, downward hit over the net? 💥
explanation: Awesome! A smash is a super strong hit that sends the birdie flying down fast! 💥

question: What do we call it when players hit the birdie back and forth many times? 🔄
explanation: Great job! A rally is a super fun time when the birdie stays in the air for a long time! 🔄

question: Before we start playing hard, what should we do to our bodies? 🤸
explanation: Fantastic! A good warm-up stretches our muscles and gets us ready to jump and play! 🤸

question: What do we need to move quickly across the big court? 🏃
explanation: Brilliant! Having fast feet helps you reach the shuttlecock before it touches the ground! 🏃

question: What is a real shuttlecock usually made of? 🪶
explanation: Super! Real shuttlecocks are made of light feathers so they can float through the air! 🪶

question: What do we do after a good game with our friends? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Shaking hands shows great respect and good sportsmanship to our friends! 🤝

question: What does playing a running game like badminton do for our body? 💪
explanation: Great job! Running and swinging makes our muscles super strong and healthy! 💪

question: What shape is the playing area of a badminton court? 🟩
explanation: Fantastic! The court has straight lines forming a big rectangle shape! 🟩
hint: It has four sides, two long and two short.

question: What connects our eyes and hands together to hit the fast shuttlecock? 🧠
explanation: Brilliant! Hand-eye coordination is the magic skill that lets our hands hit what our eyes see! 🧠
hint: Working your hands and eyes together.

question: What should we drink to stay fresh while playing sports? 💧
explanation: Super! Drinking fresh water keeps us hydrated and gives us energy to keep playing! 💧

question: Where is the best place to play badminton safely? 🏟️
explanation: Awesome! A proper sports court is the safest and best place to enjoy our game! 🏟️

question: When hitting the shuttlecock forward, our arm should do what? 💪
explanation: Great job! A big, smooth forward swing gives power to push the birdie over the net! 💪
hint: Move your arm like a pendulum.

question: What is the very soft hit that falls gently just over the net called? 🪶
explanation: Fantastic! A drop shot is a smart, gentle tap that drops right over the net! 🪶
hint: It makes the birdie fall quickly.

question: If we want to hit the shuttlecock very high and far away, we play a... 🚀
explanation: Brilliant! A high clear pushes the birdie all the way to the back of the opponent's court! 🚀

question: What do four people playing together in one game call it? 👯
explanation: Super! In doubles, two players team up against two other players for double the fun! 👯

question: What do we use to hit the shuttle on the natural side of our playing arm? ✋
explanation: Awesome! A forehand hit is when you swing naturally with your palm facing the net! ✋

question: What do we use to hit the shuttle on the opposite side of our playing arm? 🤚
explanation: Great job! A backhand hit uses the back of your hand facing the net to strike the birdie! 🤚

question: What do we stand on while waiting excitedly for the serve? 🦶
explanation: Fantastic! Standing on ready, bouncy feet helps us move in any direction instantly! 🦶

question: What helps us jump super high to smash the shuttlecock? 🦘
explanation: Brilliant! Our strong leg muscles act like springs to help us jump high in the air! 🦘
hint: The body part you stand on.

question: What happens if the shuttlecock lands completely outside the court lines? ❌
explanation: Super! If it lands outside the boundary lines, it is called 'out', and the other team gets a point! ❌

question: What do we need to focus clearly on the fast-flying shuttlecock? 👀
explanation: Awesome! Wide open, focused eyes help us track the fast speed of the birdie! 👀

question: How does a feathered shuttlecock fly through the air? ✈️
explanation: Great job! The feathers catch the air, making the shuttlecock glide smoothly like a tiny parachute! ✈️

question: What shows good sportsmanship on the badminton court? 😊
explanation: Fantastic! Cheering for friends and smiling makes the game fun and joyful for everyone! 😊

question: To hit a good shot, what must the center of our racket do? 🏸
explanation: Brilliant! The center of the racket strings must perfectly meet the flying shuttlecock! 🏸

question: How high must we hit the shuttlecock to keep playing? 🥅
explanation: Super! We always try to hit it cleanly over the net to the opponent's side! 🥅

question: Why do we bend our knees slightly in the ready position? 🤸
explanation: Awesome! Bent knees act like springs, getting us ready to run fast in any direction! 🤸
hint: Like a tiger ready to pounce.

question: What is the name of the white marks painted on the edges of the court? 📏
explanation: Great job! Boundary lines show us exactly where the playing area starts and ends! 📏

question: When learning to strike the shuttlecock, what is the most important thing? 🧠
explanation: Fantastic! Practicing again and again trains our brain and muscles to hit perfect shots! 🧠

question: Which of these exciting games is a racket sport? 🎾
explanation: Brilliant! Badminton is a famous racket sport played all over the wonderful world! 🎾
hint: It uses a racket and a birdie.

question: What should our grip on the racket handle be like? 🤝
explanation: Super! A firm but comfortable grip gives you the best control over your swings! 🤝

question: What happens when you do a good serve over the net? 🏸
explanation: Awesome! A great serve starts an exciting rally where everyone gets to play! 🏸

question: How does playing active games like badminton make us feel? 😄
explanation: Great job! Playing sports releases good energy that makes our hearts and minds very happy! 😄

question: When moving sideways on the court, what funny steps can we use? 🦀
explanation: Fantastic! Side-stepping like a crab helps us move sideways quickly without tripping! 🦀
hint: A sea animal that walks sideways.

question: What happens if you accidentally touch the net with your racket? ⚠️
explanation: Brilliant! Touching the net is a foul, so we must be careful and stay slightly back! ⚠️

question: What do we do when our teammate makes a really great shot? 👏
explanation: Super! Cheering for our teammates builds a happy and strong team spirit! 👏

question: How heavy is a good badminton racket usually? 🪶
explanation: Awesome! Rackets are made to be very light so we can swing them super fast! 🪶

question: What do we follow to make sure we play the game fairly? 📜
explanation: Great job! Following the rules keeps the game fair, safe, and fun for every single player! 📜

question: How should we toss the shuttlecock from our hand before a serve? ⬆️
explanation: Fantastic! Tossing it up gently gives us perfect time to swing and hit a great serve! ⬆️

question: What does hitting the fast shuttlecock require from us? 💪
explanation: Brilliant! It takes wonderful skill and great timing to hit the flying birdie perfectly every time! 💪
